source_checklist.locator: 10x Genomics Visium Sample Index Sets (13 June 2022), https://www.10xgenomics.com/support/spatial-gene-expression-fresh-frozen/documentation/steps/sequencing/sample-index-sets-for-visium-spatial-gene-expression, linking original Dual Index Kit TT Set A JSON https://cdn.10xgenomics.com/raw/upload/v1655151898/support/in-line%20documents/Dual_Index_Kit_TT_Set_A.json; local _data/sources/10x-visium-spatial-gene-expression/10x_Dual_Index_Kit_TT_Set_A.json

pass_1.locations: Original 10x Visium index-set page lines 48–61 and linked official JSON entries SI-TT-A1 through SI-TT-H12, 96 wells; full local source-bundle oligo scraper run before reading.
pass_1.finding: The official kit table publishes each well-specific 10-base i7 and i5 index (two i5 workflow orientations). SI-TT-A1, for example, is i7 GTAACATGCG and i5 AGTGTTACCT / reverse complement AGGTAACACT. The guide does not name which well was used in an unspecified experiment, so that variable remains run-specific rather than unpublished kit information.

pass_2.locations: Independently opened original 10x Visium index-set page lines 48–61 and parsed linked original local Dual_Index_Kit_TT_Set_A.json, keys SI-TT-A1 through SI-TT-H12; full local Visium scraper run first.
pass_2.finding: All 96 wells publish a 10-nt i7 and both 10-nt i5 orientations; workflow-B i5 is reverse complement of workflow-A. A1 is i7 GTAACATGCG, i5 AGTGTTACCT/AGGTAACACT; H12 is i7 TGATGATTCA, i5 GTAGGAGTCG/CGACTCCTAC. Kit index sequences are published; the guide does not select an experiment-specific well.

pass_1.locations: Slide-parameter original lines 94–149; Spatial Outputs original lines 153–184; full local Visium bundle scraper run first. Followed linked slide-file download instructions lines 94–96.
pass_1.finding: 10x documents that serial plus capture area downloads a slide-specific layout file and that tissue_positions.csv has 4,992 barcode-to-spot rows for the 6.5 mm slide. It says the same barcode inclusion list is bundled with Space Ranger. This locates the data rather than proving it absent; original bundle/list and actual slide serial remain to inspect. The linked instruction requires a slide serial number for a layout download; without a specified run serial there is no unique layout to assign.

pass_2.locations: Independently read official Space Ranger 2.1 slide-parameter page lines 94–149 and Space Ranger 3.1 spatial-output page lines 153–184 after full Visium scraper. Independently followed official setup page listing barcode/coordinate files.
pass_2.finding: Serial+capture-area arguments download a slide-specific layout; tissue_positions.csv has 4,992 rows on the 6.5 mm capture area, with barcode and coordinates, and the docs locate the same inclusion list inside the Space Ranger bundle. A generic inclusion list is distinct from a serial-specific calibrated layout. Neither original bundle files nor a real slide serial was inspected, so those remain open. The setup inventory specifically names visium-v1_coordinates.txt and related slide-version coordinate files.

additional_passes.finding: Recovered the 96-well TT index set. Traced the Visium barcode inclusion list to Space Ranger and slide-specific layout to serial-number download. Actual barcode list and specified physical slide are still pending, as are second reads of newly recovered sources.

missing_claims.claim: A single fixed spatial-barcode or UMI species
missing_claims.evidence: Guide defines N16 spatial barcode and N12 UMI patterns; barcode varies by slide spot and UMI by molecule.

missing_claims.claim: A fixed Dual Index TT sample index pair
missing_claims.evidence: The official TT Set A JSON publishes all 96 well-specific i7/i5 pairs; the Rev F guide specifies the kit but not the well selected in a particular experiment. This is run-specific, not an undisclosed kit sequence.

conclusion: The official Rev F guide establishes the Visium construct. Two independent readers verified the original 10x TT Set A JSON with all 96 i7/i5 pairs; a chosen well remains experiment-specific. Official Space Ranger docs locate the 4,992-spot inclusion list and per-slide layout, but the actual bundle files and a run serial remain uninspected. No absence is accepted.
